en.title: Emphasis and inversion
en.summary: English can change the usual order for emphasis; inversion puts the verb before the subject.

paragraphs: English usually keeps subject – verb order, but it can change it to give emphasis. In inversion, an auxiliary or a main verb comes before the subject, which is a form of emphasis found in formal writing, speeches and literature.

items: **Never have I seen** such a thing.
**Not only did he lie**, but he also cheated.

paragraphs: After adverbs with a negative or restrictive meaning at the beginning of a clause, the auxiliary comes before the subject. If there is no auxiliary, add do, does or did.

blocks.html:
Normal orderInverted order
I have never seen such a thing.Never have I seen such a thing.
He not only lied but also cheated.Not only did he lie, but he also cheated.
I rarely go out.Rarely do I go out.
She had hardly arrived when it began.Hardly had she arrived when it began.
I only realised later.Only later did I realise.

DeviceExample
inversion after so / suchSo loud was the noise that I woke.
place word firstHere comes the bus. Down fell the rain.
cleft sentence (It is... that)It was Tom who broke it.
What... isWhat I need is a rest.
do for emphasisI do like it!

paragraphs: Conditionals can be inverted instead of using if: Had I known, I would have called (= If I had known). Should you need help, ask (= If you should need help). Were I rich, I would travel (= If I were rich).

items: Wrong: **Never I have seen this.** Right: **Never have I seen this.**
Wrong: **Rarely she goes out.** Right: **Rarely does she go out.**
Wrong: **Hardly I arrived when...** Right: **Hardly had I arrived when...**

ro.title: Accentul și inversiunea
ro.summary: În limba română, schimbăm ordinea cuvintelor pentru a scoate în evidență o idee importantă.

paragraphs: În limba română, ordinea cuvintelor este foarte flexibilă. Adesea punem verbul înaintea subiectului pentru a atrage atenția. Această schimbare simplă a ordinii cuvintelor se numește inversiune.

items: Niciodată **nu a auzit** Maria o astfel de poveste.

paragraphs: Limba română nu folosește cuvinte speciale pentru a schimba ordinea. Mutăm doar verbul sau cuvântul important la începutul propoziției. Subiectul poate trece fără probleme după verb. Intonația vocii ajută și ea la sublinierea ideii.

blocks.html:
Ordine normalăCu inversiuneAccentul
Autobuzul vine.**Vine** autobuzul.Pe acțiune
Tata a sunat.A sunat **tata**.Pe persoană
Nu am văzut asta niciodată.**Niciodată** nu am văzut asta.Pe negație
Mihai este aici.**Aici** este Mihai.Pe loc
